location.zh: 帕诺星系 各星球（随机出现）

label.zh: 周一、周五：2回合内击败盖亚
周二、周四、周日：用致命一击击败盖亚
周三、周六：对战10回合后再击败盖亚（提前击败无效）

capture.zh: 盖亚每天13:00和20:00各出现30分钟，随机出现在帕诺星系的星球上（派特博士会通知）；按当天曜日的规则击败才能获得盖亚精元，没按规则打败不给精元。首次击败获成就「击败盖亚」，三种规则全部完成获「完胜盖亚」。

strategy_notes.zh: 2回合规则：先消强化，用克制战斗系的超能/飞行精灵（艾克里桑、闪尼、艾贝多芬）两下或一次暴击打死，或秒杀技；致命一击规则：同上，靠运气或致命能量珠；10回合规则：伊娅丝魔力针刺消强、虚弱光线减攻后加血硬撑，或该隐暗影护盾轮流抵挡，满10回合后再打死。

engine_notes: Three weekday objectives become variants the player picks (no real-time clock). The top-level win is plain ko_all for a free practice fight (practice_fight), which keeps no attempt or clear record; the 精元 is granted only when a variant's objectives are met.
ko_after_turn {turns:10}: KOing 盖亚 before turn 10 ends the battle as a failure (提前击败无法获得精元). Counts 10 of its turns/attacks.
turn_limit {turns:2} as a win objective = won within 2 turns.
Innate boost (天生强化，需消除) — stat and amount not stated; atk+1 assumed.
Level not given in any source found; 70 is an estimate (2010 帕诺星系 legendaries).
Hourly windows (13:00/20:00 30 min) are dropped per foundation 7.2.
reward_hatches 260: 盖亚精元 hatches the initial form 提坦 at Lv1, which evolves into 盖亚 at Lv31, as the original 分子转化器 hatched the base form of every essence line (the earlier binding hatched a Lv1 盖亚).
source_note: 7k7k 盖亚 pages (2010-04-12, 2011-03-16): HP 2000, 战斗系, 天生强化, weekday rules; 4399 Q&A confirms the rules and 2000 HP.
